nodes.name: crd.template.footer.yaml
nodes.summary: One-line Helm template footer that closes the conditional block opened by the CRD header template.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains only a Go template end action, so it is meaningful solely in combination with the header template.

nodes.name: crd.template.header.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm template header that generates a CustomResourceDefinition, conditionally adding the keep resource-policy annotation and standard labels.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses REPLACE_* placeholder tokens that the build system substitutes per CRD.

nodes.name: crds_dir.README.md
nodes.summary: Warns that the CRDs directory holds source definitions for reference and development only, consumed by officially supported deployment methods such as the Helm chart.
